comment: Calibrated against backgrounds/castle_ricochet_board_01.png (1672x941) by dark-pixel cluster analysis of the four painted pits. Coordinates are in the logical 1664x936 board space. RUNTIME NOTE: Android WebView cannot reliably fetch() file:// JSON, so ricochet.js embeds an identical copy of this data (RICO_MAP). Keep both in sync.
pitZoneNote: 2026-08-04 metal-rim pass: pitZones are now the VISIBLE opening of each hole — the ellipse props/prop_hole_rim_metal.png draws its inner edge on and the ellipse a token must enter to sink. Centres moved 8-12px up onto the painted openings (all four were low by the same amount) and ry snapped to the rim sprite's opening aspect 1.3305 so the rim scales all but uniformly. The two top pits are painted much smaller than the bottom two, so their rx dropped from 70 to 53/55 — at 70 the rim opening overhung the hole and showed lit stone lip inside the metal. Each pit now sits on the largest ellipse that fits inside its painted hole, which is where the bottom two already were. Rim placement ratios live in ricochet.js RIM_GEO and are regenerated by scripts/build-hole-rim-sprite.js.
